source.high_z_support: The analytic function is selected as an explicit phenomenological continuation over 8<zbar<=20. It is not claimed to be measured or calibrated there; model uncertainty is separate from numerical convergence. No tabulated provider is extrapolated.
source.cosmology_conversion: Use published numerical MD14 fit as a chosen comoving source law in the reference cosmology; no claim of re-fitting its observed luminosity dataset to Planck.
source.spectral_model: photon-number shape phi(E) proportional to E^2/expm1(E/(kB_eV*Tstar)), normalized to integral 1 on selected support
source.spectral_choice_source: https://arxiv.org/html/2304.02038v2, discussion following eq3 and eq4; https://arxiv.org/abs/1405.5473
source.spectral_scope: Idealized O-star-like blackbody shape, not a stellar-population synthesis spectrum or empirical EoR spectral fit. Truncation at 100 eV is part of model; report omitted blackbody tail fraction separately.
source.proper_spectral_rate: escaped_total_comoving_rate/(mpc_cm^3*a^3)*phi(E), photons cm^-3 s^-1 eV^-1 integrated over solid angle
source.angular_density: proper_spectral_rate/(4*pi); apply angle weights exactly once when making cell-integrated photon stocks

clock.origin: elapsed proper time since each matched zbar=20 initial slice
clock.donor_velocity_conversion: No donor four-velocity consumed; chosen non-tilted IC has n=(1,0,0,0) in x0=ct, U=(c,0,0,0).

initial_radiation.ionizing_photons: Exactly zero by chosen source-switch-on IC at zbar20; this is an explicit idealized IC, not a missing donor field filled with zero.
initial_radiation.cmb_reference: Isotropic blackbody at a_ref with T=Tcmb0/a_ref; Tcmb0/a later is the isotropic Compton reference approximation, not exact directional temperature.
initial_radiation.scope: No pre-zbar20 astrophysical photons or gas photoheating. Source onset and prehistory uncertainty remain conditional IC assumptions.

point_input: zbar on gas-proper clock via scale factor a; source law is redshift parameterized

quadrature.change: Preauthorized deterministic quadrature repair after preserved failed1e-7 cell energy moment check
quadrature.cell_normalization: sum actual N_i, same denominator for energy; E_i=U_i/N_i
quadrature.driver_fixed_q_requirement: AX05 maps proper isotropic source onto covariant rays with solid-angle Jacobian and normalizes finite quadrature once; baseline weights are local angular representation

tail_diagnostic: Integral100..500eV divided by13.6..500; no physical injection beyond100eV
